summary: Finalized the runtime audit as an explicitly historical record plus the completed GameScreen topology, and corrected persistence documentation to match the current memory-only runtime. The backend handoff covers every required domain with typed read/command ports, honest unavailable states, and a wiring sequence that replaces providers without redesigning the UI.

commands.evidence: PoliticsViewPort, EconomyViewPort with shared population, ordered-pair RelationshipViewPort with -100..100 validation, WarsViewPort plus separate geometry, DiplomacyViewPort plus nullable DiplomacyChannelPort, and nullable GameSavePort are all specified.

Pre-refactor ownership/lifecycle/coupling is labeled historical; the final section names one GameScreen turn controller, one overlay reducer, and one major-event acknowledgement queue. Persistence now states that player/runtime state is browser-memory-only, reload returns to setup, production has no browser storage path, and Save remains backend-pending.
All handoff port names and nullable diplomacy/save command ports exist in src/lib/game-ui/contracts.ts.

knownLimitations: Politics, economy/population, bilateral relationships, wars/front geometry, diplomacy service, and server save remain intentionally unconnected authoritative domains.
No durable save or reload resume exists until the authoritative GameSavePort is connected.
